title: UW Markdown Module Manifest
description: Declarative third-party module manifest. Normative Protocol §X; no executable code. requires_conformance and requires_profiles replace requires_tier (RFC 0081).

id.description: Stable identifier; reverse-DNS recommended, e.g. com.example.specialty.

requires_protocol.description: Semver range satisfied by Protocol 4.0.0. No older contract is admitted.

asset_classes.description: Asset classes this module is intended for. Omit to indicate the module is class-agnostic.

sections.description: Custom or extended section declarations: extend a standard section with additional optional fields, or add module-namespaced sections. New asset_class VALUES are declared separately, in `declares_asset_classes` (RFC 0003) — this field is about sections.

schema.description: JSON Schema fragment for the section content. Validated by the calc host on load.

required.description: If true, the host treats this section as mandatory for the declared deal_stages.

calculations.description: Custom calculations contributed by this module. Each is a safe-expression formula evaluated by a Tier-3 calc host.

formula.description: Safe-expression string. Grammar: arithmetic, comparison, conditional, function call only. See UW_PROTOCOL.md §VIII.1.

unit.description: Display unit (e.g. '%', '$', 'x'). Also selects the default round_to when round_to is omitted — see UW_PROTOCOL.md §VIII.5.

round_to.description: Decimal places the reported value is quantized to, half away from zero (UW_PROTOCOL.md §VIII.5). Omit to take the normative default for `unit` ($ = 2, % = 6, x = 4, otherwise 6). This is a precision contract that receipt digests depend on, not a display hint.

deterministic.description: MUST be true in v1. Reserved for v2 stochastic calcs.

section_roles.description: Role preference per section id for this calculation's reads of a role-bearing variant map (UW_PROTOCOL.md §VIII.2, RFC 0066). The unique eligible block with this _role is read; with none, RFC 0040's generic order applies; with two, the read refuses CALC-RESOLVE-002. An explicit sectionVariants entry still wins. A component is never selected this way.

validations.description: Cross-section consistency rules contributed by this module.

rule.description: Safe-expression returning boolean. true = passes; false = emits the message.

thresholds.description: Partial override of FinancialThresholds defaults. Only properties present are overridden.

view_models.description: Per-section view-model overrides. Replaces BUILTIN_VIEW_MODELS entries for matching section_id.

ui.description: Free-form host-specific UI hints. Hosts MAY ignore unrecognized keys.

agent_layers.description: Bancroft-style agent layer declarations contributed by this module.

prompt_template.description: Template body for the layer's system prompt. Placeholders use {{ section.field }} syntax resolved by the agent host.

depends_on.description: Other modules this one requires. The host MUST refuse to load if a dependency is missing or version-incompatible.

declares_asset_classes.description: Optional. Custom asset classes this module introduces (§X.2, RFC 0003). Distinct from `asset_classes`, which names builtin classes the module ENHANCES; a module may do both.

id.description: Reverse-DNS, at least three lower-snake-case segments. Ownership is fixed at the identifier, so two hosts can never disagree about whose class this is. A final segment matching a builtin name is refused (INVALID-ASSET-CLASS-002).

fallback.description: The closest builtin, for readers that do not hold this module. Omitting it is a deliberate choice that no approximation is honest, and costs those readers the document entirely (MOD-MISSING-001 rather than MOD-FALLBACK-001).

signature.description: Optional. Detached signature over the canonical manifest (§X.1, RFC 0002). Advisory: what to do with an unsigned module, or one whose signature fails, is a host-policy decision.

requires_conformance.description: Minimum claimed conformance tier (Protocol §VII.4). Below it is PROTO-MOD-029; unknown value is PROTO-MOD-006.

requires_profiles.description: Every listed profile must be claimed by the host (PROTO-MOD-029); absent means none. Unknown profiles are PROTO-MOD-006.

path.description: Dot-path within the section's content, resolved via parser.deepGet.
